title: Product Manager, Digital Lending
description:
**Arbor Credit Union** serves 180,000 members across Ontario.

**The role**
You'll own digital lending: personal loans, lines of credit and mortgage pre-approval online.

**What you'll do**
* Own the digital loan application and approval journey
* Work with Credit Risk and Lending Operations on decisioning rules
* Improve application completion and time to decision
* Manage our lending platform vendor

**What you'll bring**
* 4+ years of product management in banking or lending
* Experience with digital applications, credit decisioning or KYC
* Vendor management experience

**Benefits**
$115,000 to $135,000, bonus, defined-contribution pension, hybrid (2 days a week).

title: Group Product Manager, Booking
description:
**Halcyon** is an online travel company booking 4 million trips a year.

**The role**
As Group Product Manager, Booking, you'll lead a team of 4 product managers responsible for search, checkout and payments.

**Responsibilities**
* Set strategy and goals for the booking funnel (look-to-book conversion)
* Hire, coach and grow a team of 4 PMs
* Run a rigorous experimentation program across web and app
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science and Revenue leadership

**Requirements**
* 10+ years of product management, 3+ years managing product managers
* Deep experience with high-traffic consumer conversion funnels and payments
* Strong experimentation and analytics background

**Compensation**
$175,000 to $200,000 base, bonus, equity, fully remote.

title: Senior Product Manager, Platform APIs
description:
**Sparrow HR** is an HR platform for 5,000 mid-market companies.

**The role**
You'll own our public APIs, webhooks and developer platform used by 300 integration partners.

**What you'll do**
* Own API strategy, versioning and developer experience
* Write technical specs with engineering; review API designs
* Grow the partner ecosystem with our partnerships team
* Track API adoption, reliability and partner satisfaction

**Requirements**
* 6+ years of product management for developer-facing or platform products
* Former software engineer or equivalent technical depth strongly preferred
* Hands-on with REST, OAuth, webhooks and API documentation tools

**Compensation**
$150,000 to $170,000 base, equity, fully remote in Canada.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Nimbus Retail** runs 120 home-goods stores and a growing online shop.

**About the role**
Our Associate Product Manager program is a 2-year rotation for early-career product people.

**You'll**
* Support a senior PM on the e-commerce checkout
* Write user stories and help run sprint ceremonies
* Analyze customer feedback and funnel data

**You have**
* 0 to 2 years of experience in product, analytics or consulting
* A degree in business, computer science or a related field
* Curiosity and strong communication skills

**Pay**
$75,000 to $90,000, hybrid (3 days a week in our Toronto head office).

title: Directeur(trice) produit numérique, Adhésion client
description:
**Banque Westgate** recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) produit numérique pour l'adhésion client.

**Votre rôle**
* Piloter le parcours d'ouverture de compte en ligne et mobile
* Collaborer avec la Conformité et les Opérations
* Améliorer le taux de complétion et la satisfaction client

**Exigences**
* 6 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de produit
* Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit (obligatoire)
* Expérience en services financiers

**Rémunération**
140 000 $ à 160 000 $, prime annuelle, mode hybride à Montréal.

title: Product Operations Manager
description:
**Oakridge Energy** is modernizing the digital tools used by 3,000 field technicians.

**The role**
You'll run product operations for our digital field services team: planning, release management, metrics and training.

**Responsibilities**
* Run quarterly planning and release calendars
* Build adoption dashboards for field tools
* Coordinate training and change management with field operations

**Requirements**
* 4+ years in product operations, product management or PMO
* Change management experience
* Willing to work on-site in Calgary 5 days a week with occasional field travel

**Compensation**
$120,000 to $135,000 plus bonus.

title: Senior Product Manager, Underwriting Platform
description:
**Vantage Insurance Group** writes commercial insurance for 90,000 Canadian businesses.

**The role**
You'll own the underwriting workbench that 400 underwriters use to quote and bind commercial policies.

**What you'll do**
* Own the underwriting platform roadmap and adoption
* Partner with Underwriting leadership, Actuarial and IT
* Introduce automation and AI-assisted triage to cut quote turnaround time
* Manage our core policy administration vendor relationship

**About you**
* 6+ years of product management, insurance experience required
* Experience with internal or B2B workflow tools
* Vendor management and enterprise delivery experience

**Compensation**
$145,000 to $165,000, bonus, fully remote in Canada.

title: Product Manager, Monetization
description:
**Glimmer Games** makes mobile puzzle games with 9 million monthly players.

**The role**
You'll own in-game monetization: offers, the store, battle pass and pricing.

**Responsibilities**
* Own revenue per daily active user and payer conversion
* Design and analyze live-ops offers and pricing experiments
* Partner with game designers, data scientists and UA

**Requirements**
* 3+ years of product management in mobile games or consumer apps
* Hands-on experimentation and SQL
* Passion for games

**Compensation**
$115,000 to $135,000, bonus, hybrid in Montréal (3 days a week).

title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Prescriptions
companyIndustry: Retail Health and Personal Care Products
description:
**Meridian Pharmacy** operates 450 pharmacies across Canada.

**The role**
You'll own digital prescriptions: refills, transfers, reminders and delivery in our app.

**What you'll do**
* Grow digital refill adoption and reduce in-store wait times
* Partner with Pharmacy Operations, Privacy and IT
* Lead a cross-functional squad and own the roadmap
* Launch new features across 450 stores with operations readiness

**What you bring**
* 6+ years of product management for consumer apps
* Health care or regulated industry experience
* Experience launching across a large operations network

**What we offer**
Competitive salary and bonus, employee discount, hybrid work in Toronto.

title: Product Manager, Trading Platform
description:
**Bluefin Capital Markets** builds trading systems for institutional fixed income desks.

**The role**
You'll own our order management system used by traders and portfolio managers.

**Responsibilities**
* Gather requirements from trading desks and translate them into detailed specs
* Work with low-latency engineering teams on order routing features
* Support regulatory reporting changes (IIROC/CIRO)

**Requirements**
* 5+ years of product management or business analysis in capital markets
* Deep knowledge of fixed income trading workflows and FIX protocol
* On-site 5 days a week on our Toronto trading floor

**Compensation**
$130,000 to $150,000, discretionary bonus.

title: Product Manager (6-month contract)
description:
**Summit Staffing Partners** is hiring a Product Manager for a 6-month contract with a national bank client.

**Responsibilities**
* Own the backlog for a mobile banking feature team
* Write user stories and run sprint planning
* Coordinate releases with QA and IT

**Requirements**
* 5+ years of product management in banking
* Available immediately for a 6-month contract (possible extension)

**Rate**
$85 to $95 per hour, incorporated or T4.

title: Senior Product Manager, Ad Platform
description:
**Echo Media Group** runs digital advertising across 40 Canadian news and lifestyle sites.

**The role**
You'll own our programmatic ad platform: yield optimization, ad formats and advertiser tools.

**Responsibilities**
* Grow revenue per thousand impressions while protecting reader experience
* Partner with Ad Sales and Ad Operations
* Own the roadmap for header bidding and first-party data products

**Requirements**
* 6+ years of product management, ad tech strongly preferred
* Experience with programmatic advertising and yield optimization

**Compensation**
$140,000 to $160,000, bonus, hybrid in Toronto.

description: Parallax Systems is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build payment processing services in Go and Kotlin. 6+ years of backend engineering experience required.
